# sartawi.dev

Personal site of Mohammad Salah (Mo) — 15-year-old Full Stack Developer
based in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. Minimal, warm-cream design with dark mode.

## About

- Full Stack Developer focused on TypeScript, Next.js, and Go
- Contact: me@sartawi.dev

## Projects

- untap — https://github.com/mnsartawi/untap
- clak — mechanical keyboard sounds emulator app (Tauri) — https://github.com/mnsartawi/clak
- cdn — https://cdn.sartawi.dev
- quranbuddy — https://qb.sartawi.dev
- 38-0 — Discord bot for the RFL community, based on the 38-0 Premier League game

## Site

- Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion
- Features: theme toggle (light/dark/system), Quran audio player with five
  reciters, live coding-activity presence, GitHub contributions graph
- Source: https://github.com/mnsartawi/sartawi.dev
